 ADVERTISEMENT   Filtered By: Showbiz Showbiz Ethan Benares looking forward to work with Gehlee Dangca after 'PBB Collab 3.0' 
 By GMA News Published November 19, 2026 8:48pm 
 + Add GMA on Google Make this your preferred source to get more updates from this publisher on Google. Former “Pinoy Big Brother Collab 3.0” housemate Ethan Benares expressed interest in working with fellow housemate Gehlee Dangca in the future following their close bond inside Bahay ni Kuya. 
 In Aubrey Carampel’s report on “24 Oras” on Thursday, Ethan opened up on his bond with Gehlee. 
 “At the end of the day, we care for each other as friends. And of course, I'm worried for her. I hope she's doing well in the house,” Ethan said. 
 “I think she's gonna do a lot of good things naman,” he added. 
 Their closeness inside the PBB house caught the attention of viewers, with some fans even shipping the two.
 Despite being the first Kapuso housemate to leave “PBB Collab 3.0,” Ethan considers his experience a valuable stepping stone in his acting career.
 “My biggest stepping stone was PBB. It really helped my career, especially as a new artist. So, I'm just happy na I was able to experience it,” Ethan shared.
 For Ethan, he doesn’t mind if he’s the last or first to go out of the house. 
 “I told the housemates I really don't mind if I'm the last to go out or the first to go out. To me, I just want to continue working on my acting career. And now that I'm back, I mean, it's time to work hard again.” 
 The Sporty Palangga ng Bacolod said he was overwhelmed by the warm welcome he received from fans following his eviction from the PBB house. 
 His homecoming became even more emotional when he was reunited with his mother, whom he had not seen for six months.
 “I was very, very, very, very happy when I saw my mom. I just broke down because, you know, after six months of being stressed, working hard, and being homesick, I just let it all out in that hug. There's really nothing like a mother's hug," he said in Filipino and English. 
 Before joining the PBB house, Ethan also competed in “Sparkle Campus Cutie Season 2.” Although he did not win the competition, he considers the experience a redirection. 
 “Sometimes, you don't get everything in life. Sometimes, you don't even win all the time, and that's okay. We have to realize that when we win, that's one of our biggest achievements, and when we lose it's a lesson as well,” he said.
 Ethan and Gehlee shared a close bond inside the PBB house. 
 Before he was evicted last Saturday, they wrote a song together titled " Lullaby ."
 Ethan exited Bahay Ni Kuya alongside Calix Esguerra .
 Meanwhile, Allen Ansay , Ronnie Pasamba, Daniela Stranner, Lorelaine Sañosa entered PBB as the newest addition to the housemates.
 "PBB: Collab 3.0" premiered on October 24. The reality series airs on GMA Network from Mondays to Fridays at 9:35 p.m., Saturdays at 6:15 p.m., and Sundays at 4:55 p.m.
 —Jade Veronique Yap/CDC, GMA News
